{{Top|leg}}
The '''Halbegardian elite''' was a military division that served the nation of [[Halbegardia]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]]. During the [[Adumari Civil War]], they participated as ground troops of the confederacy against [[Cartann]].<ref name="soa">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>
